description: Long-running daemon. Every 300s, queries mcp_registry_facts via WriteService /query for up to 100 server_ids that have no matching row in mcp_server_registry. For each, builds a canonical registry row (server_id, source, first_seen, last_updated, transport, repo_url, package_name) from the facts and POSTs to WriteService /write with table='mcp_server_registry', wait=True. Sends heartbeat to service_health every 30s in a daemon thread. Single-instance lockfile at /home/workspace/logs/registry_promoter_daemon.lock with PID. NEVER imports duckdb or sqlite3. Uses requests + json + threading only. Writes structured INFO log lines on each batch with promoted_count. Closes the 4545 mcp_registry_facts rows that have no canonical mcp_server_registry entry.
